name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
description: Creates multiple clones of the user to confuse enemies.

name: Transformation Jutsu
description: Allows the user to transform into another person or object.

name: Fireball Jutsu
description: Shoots a large fireball at the enemy.

name: Lightning Blade
description: A concentrated lightning attack that pierces through enemies.

name: Water Dragon Jutsu
description: Summons a dragon made of water to attack enemies.

name: Earth Wall Jutsu
description: Creates a defensive wall made of earth.

name: Wind Blade Jutsu
description: Enhances a weapon with wind chakra for sharper attacks.

name: Summoning Jutsu
description: Summons a creature to assist in battle.

name: Rasengan
description: A spinning ball of chakra that deals massive damage.

name: Chidori
description: A high-speed lightning attack that pierces through enemies.

name: Sage Mode
description: Enhances the user's physical and chakra abilities.

name: Amaterasu
description: Summons black flames that burn anything they touch.

name: Susano'o
description: Creates a giant chakra warrior for defense and attack.

name: Tailed Beast Bomb
description: A massive chakra blast used by tailed beasts.

name: Flying Thunder God Technique
description: Allows instant teleportation to marked locations.

name: Reaper Death Seal
description: Seals the enemy's soul at the cost of the user's life.

name: Infinite Tsukuyomi
description: Traps all enemies in an eternal illusion.

name: Creation Rebirth
description: Heals the user completely by consuming chakra.

name: Rinnegan Techniques
description: Unlocks various abilities such as gravity manipulation and soul extraction.

name: Eight Gates Release
description: Unlocks the user's full physical potential at the cost of their life.
